mapper.insert: INSERT INTO files (board_id, origin_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, file_format) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{originName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileFormat})
mapper.select: SELECT id, board_id, origin_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, file_format FROM files WHERE board_id = #{boardId} ORDER BY id
